summary_1line: Ravana invades the realm of the gods, a massive battle erupts, and the Vasu Savitra slays Ravana’s powerful grandfather Sumali in combat.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana’s vast Rakshasa army floods the heavens as he arrives at Indra’s realm like a roaring ocean surrounding the city of the gods.
Indra, uneasy on his throne, addresses the assembled gods while turning toward Vishnu for protection against the advancing Ravana.
The Vasu Savitra smashes his blazing mace down on Sumali’s head like a meteor striking a mountain amid the chaos of battle.
